findings.title: Team admin check requires both admin AND owner
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner uses && between isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner. A team admin who is not also the owner fails the check and cannot add guests. It should use ||.

findings.title: New-guest emails use the unfiltered guests list
findings.body: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw `guests` input instead of `uniqueGuests`. An existing attendee who is resubmitted in the list is matched as a 'new guest' and gets a scheduled-booking email instead of the update email. Pass uniqueGuests.

findings.title: Blacklist and duplicate checks are case-sensitive
findings.body: Blacklisted emails are lowercased but the guest emails are not, so a mixed-case address such as Foo@x.com bypasses the blacklist. Comparison against existing attendees is also case-sensitive, so the same person can be added again with different casing.

findings.title: Any attendee can add unlimited guests, triggering emails to arbitrary addresses
findings.body: Any attendee is authorized, there is no cap on the length of the guests array, and the event type's guest settings are not checked. This lets anyone who booked a meeting send calendar invites/emails from the platform to arbitrary addresses (spam vector).

findings.title: Calendar update uses the caller's credentials, not the organizer's
findings.body: EventManager is built from ctx.user and that user's credentials. When an attendee or team admin calls the endpoint, the organizer's calendar event is updated with the wrong credentials, so it fails or is skipped. The organizer's credentials (booking.user) should be used.

findings.title: Calendar update failure aborts after the DB write
findings.body: The attendees are already persisted when updateCalendarAttendees runs, and its errors are not caught. If it throws, the client sees an error even though the guests were saved, and no emails are sent.

findings.title: Error toast fallback never used
findings.body: `message` is always a non-empty template string, possibly 'undefined: ...'. Because of that, the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback in the toast is never reached.

findings.title: Invalid-email error never clears
findings.body: isInvalidEmail is set to true on a failed validation but is never reset when validation later succeeds or after a successful add. A stale error message stays visible in the dialog.
